metadata.sprint: MG0-A AlphaGenome Official Code Parity Audit

local_parity_checks: git diff upstream/main..HEAD -- src/alphagenome_research produced no diff
evidence_boundaries: CODE_OBSERVED: model, heads, losses, loaders, evaluation, fine-tuning, prediction and scoring code
PUBLISHED_ONLY: pretraining recipe, fold construction details, all-fold teachers, distillation, mutations and sequence-parallel trainer
EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: fold enums and ISM enumeration are partly supplied by the separate alphagenome package
DESIGN_INFERENCE: every MarketGenome analogue and causal modification

component_map.official_code_evidence: attention.py:177-299 constructs /2048 sequence-to-pair features, full row attention and pair-derived bias

non_negotiable_alpha_genome_principles: Long context is an explicit ablation dimension whose value must be demonstrated.
Dense aligned multi-resolution predictions are first-class outputs.
Multi-task modalities use typed heads, explicit masks, declared scaling and inspectable loss weights.
Evaluation is held out, overlap-aware and performed after design choices are frozen.
Teacher training and student evaluation have distinct data-provenance contracts.
Effect scoring compares paired inputs under the same frozen model and reports per-task deltas.
Perturbation validity is domain-specific and tested before effects are interpreted.
Target resolution, context length, modalities and teacher count require controlled ablations.
Missing labels and padded tracks contribute no gradient.
Compute-heavy components require measured benefit and parity tests before adoption.
non_isomorphic_components: Bidirectional DNA context and unmasked attention are invalid for market-time prediction.
Reverse complement and strand equivariance have no valid reverse-time market analogue.
Symmetric genomic contact-map targets have no validated market target contract.
DNA one-hot identity and nucleotide substitutions or indels do not preserve market invariants.
Genomic spatial folds must become purged chronological walk-forward folds.
Organism identity and species-specific heads differ from symbol and regime generalization.
Splice donor-acceptor junction ontology has no defined market counterpart.
Gene, exon, TSS, PAS and strand masks cannot be renamed into market concepts.
Poisson counts and positive softplus outputs are not valid defaults for signed returns.
